Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Solid Pine Rustic Farmhouse Console Table, 52"W, Rustic Oak
Colors: Rustic Oak
Materials: Pine
This console table’s light finish and simple design mean it will be home with any decor—traditional or modern. X-shaped detailing on the sides provides dimension in any space. Sturdy pine construction and two wide shelves make this table a great storage option as well as a stylish focal point. 52"W x 15"D x 30"H Solid pine construction The simple design features two split shelves to store your small items. Solid wood construction creates a sturdy base to help keep items secure. Use this piece as the perfect finishing touch for your farmhouse decor or as a way to add a rustic touch to your existing design scheme. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Avoid moisture. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
